notes: The centred title is “Errors in 1st 100 pages of notes + letter to Quillen.” The 100 pages describe the extent of the notes under review; the sheet itself bears no internal page number or date.

The Quillen-letter section contains five page/line correction entries. It contrasts “Commute with” and “commute to”, proposes a wording that “would be more normal”, compares standard with a corrected handwritten error, notes the missing article the, and underlines ies in categories.

The Reflections section contains twelve page/line entries, from page 1 to page 41. The page 5 suggestion “manifold” is qualified as “would be more usual”; page 21 says “n-tuples” “is I believe correct.”
For page 32 line 17, “(middle of page)” and “probably” qualify the suggested modelizer. One opening quotation stroke and paired closing strokes are preserved.

At page 34 line 6 the writer says “which allow...” is not clear in sense, discusses an object after allow with to, says the proposed construction “doesn't seem to be right here”, and distinguishes “Allow for”.

The final entry prefers “we have” to “we got”, calls the latter American, and uses a therefore sign before the comparison with 16th and 17th century English. The connector between the centuries remains uncertain as or or ampersand.
Archive sheet number 16 is retained only as a comment. No diagrams, drawings, displayed mathematics, dates, or signatures occur.

brief_feedback: The full image and each supplied half were displayed once, in that order. Five unresolved loci were listed in view_log.json and received one enhanced tight crop each; all five crops were then displayed, with no second crop or re-opening of settled areas. All words, punctuation, quote shapes, references, underlines and the overwrite were compared with C from the ink. C_context confirmations are included in c_doubts even when literal C remains unchanged; the two explicit uncertainty macros are resolved or narrowed. H is descriptive only, so no H collation rows were manufactured. Inventory covers all text blocks/list entries, each nested underline, the deletion and its live overwrite, and the archive comment; there are no diagram/drawing entries because none is present. No mathematical assertion was proved or tested: n-tuples is a spelling recommendation and the therefore sign is part of a linguistic comment, so math_checks is empty.
